question: President Murmu appreciates Madhubani & Gond Art. The meeting of artists with the President was part of which programme?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Artists in Residence – Kala Utsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• President Murmu appreciates Madhubani & Gond Art under Artists- in- Residence programme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Madhubani** and **Gond** artists met **President Droupadi Murmu**.

 
 
• 
 
The occasion was part of the **Artists in Residence – Kala Utsav** programme.

 
 
• 
 
This programme showcases **folk, tribal, and traditional art** at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.

 
 
• 
 
The President **viewed the artworks** created during the artists' stay.
